Smooth cluster labels across spatial neighborhoods

Source: R/utils_region.R
region_utils_smooth_cluster.Rd

For each pixel, replaces its cluster label with the most common label among its 8 spatial neighbors if a majority exists, otherwise retains the original label. Used to reduce noise in spatial cluster assignments.

Usage

region_utils_smooth_cluster(metadata.sub, cluster.col)

Arguments

metadata.sub

Data frame of sample metadata for a single sample (must include columns 'Sample', 'pixel_id', 'x_tf', 'y_tf', and the cluster column).

cluster.col

Name of the column containing cluster labels to smooth.

Value

Named character vector of smoothed cluster labels (names are pixel IDs).

Details

Uses parallel processing to speed up smoothing across all pixels. Calls region_utils_select_majority_label for each pixel.
